'''Captain Piett Cloud City Clouds''' is a [[Light]] Clouds list posted under the handle Captain Piett on 1 February 1998.<ref name="list-33861">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/33861.html? swccg-discussion message #33861], From: Captain Piett (1 February 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000110225122/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/33861.html? Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="list-33860">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/33860.html? swccg-discussion message #33860], nmm quoting Captain Piett (1 February 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000110211737/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/33860.html? Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' Captain Piett
* '''Published:''' 1 February 1998
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]] (from the card pool)
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bespin|CC-L-bespin.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City drain/Clouds
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCC Clouds Piett LS 1998.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Piett wrote that Light Cloud City drain and Clouds had been a problem, and asked for help.

== Strategy ==

Drain in the Clouds with a Tibanna Gas Miner on Cloud City, and take a little more on the ground. Subversive interrupts buy time.
